item.title: Connect360: Don’t Be Foolish
item.description: Lesson Three in the Connect360 unit “Psalms: The Believer’s Prayer Book” focuses on Psalm 14:1–7.

item.title: Communio and Texas Baptists announce partnership
item.description: The Baptist General Convention of Texas announced a partnership with national marriage ministry Communio, aimed at offering church marriage support.

item.title: Letter: GOP leadership downplays anti-Muslim hate
item.description: A Baptist Standard reader responds to recent anti-Muslim social media posts and comments by U.S. Congressmen.

item.title: Coalition champions religious freedom in Texas schools
item.description: Organizations across Texas urged families to reject Senate Bill 11, which encourages state-mandated time for prayer in schools.

item.title: Muslim schools excluded from Texas voucher program
item.description: A Texan sued Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton and Comptroller Kelly Hancock, alleging Islamic schools are excluded from the new voucher program.

item.title: Beth Moore kicks off Ascent launch
item.description: Author and Bible teacher Beth Moore, along with Texas Baptists Executive Director Julio Guarneri and other speakers, kicked off the official launch of Ascent.

item.title: Editorial: Mission, not doctrine, should drive the train
item.description: Mission and doctrine each have their place, and they need to be kept in their right place to move the train down the track in joy.

item.title: Gaza ministry offers support amid war
item.description: The founding president of humanitarian outreach organization Christian Mission to Gaza shared an update on the ground in light of the war.

item.title: Christian influencers read Bible to wake up ‘apathetic church’
item.description: Political activist and Christian organizer Bunni Pounds has recruited nearly 500 Christian leaders to read the Bible aloud in Washington this April.

item.title: Celebrating Churches: Purvey launches Full Life Church
item.description: Robert Purvey, Texas Baptists NextGen strategist, launched Full Life Church, a new church plant in northern Grand Prairie. Purvey said the church’s journey began with a clear sense of divine timing.
